title: KnockGS:interaction-Grounded Calibrationof Physical Gaussian Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.27365v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-integrated 3D Gaussian representations now allow reconstructed deformable objects to be simulated and rendered under explicit material models. Existing pipelines, however, assume that material parameters are known or manually specified, limiting their applicability when these parameters must be inferred from observed object dynamics. We propose KnockGS, an interaction-response PhysicalGS framework that estimates the elasticity and density scales of a 3D Gaussian object from its dynamics under a known applied force. translated_title: KnockGS：基于交互校准的物理高斯表示
translated_abstract: 集成物理的3D高斯表示现在允许在显式材料模型下对重建的可变形物体进行模拟和渲染。然而，现有流程假设材料参数已知或手动指定，这限制了当这些参数必须从观测到的物体动态中推断时的适用性。我们提出KnockGS，一种交互响应物理高斯框架，该框架在已知施加力下，从3D高斯物体的动态中估计其弹性和密度尺度。我们不将物理模拟仅视为正向过程，而是将力诱导的响应转化为校准信号：从观测动态中提取时间响应特征，从这些特征中估计两个材料尺度，然后将估计结果冻结并写回同一模拟器，以便在从未拟合过的交互上进行测试。我们评估了该框架。
tldr: 我们提出KnockGS，通过将物理模拟中的力诱导响应作为校准信号，从动态中估计3D高斯物体的弹性和密度尺度，并冻结回写模拟器以测试未知交互。
en_tdlr: We propose KnockGS, which uses force-induced responses in physical simulation as calibration signals to estimate elasticity and density scales of 3D Gaussian objects from dynamics, then freezes and writes them back to test unseen interactions.
